section_summary.extract_value: This section describes preliminary data analyses examining univariate and multivariate normality of the dataset. Skewness values ranged from −0.14 to 0.96 and kurtosis values ranged from −0.22 to 1.56, indicating no severe violations of normal distribution according to Kline's criteria. The section does not contain study-level metadata or participant characteristics.
